text: A resident pushes her tray away again. "Not hungry, dear." {boss} is watching the clock.

up.label: Feed her by hand for the whole shift

risk.result: The rest of the ward falls behind.

text: A resident's son slips you an envelope. "For looking after Dad." It's against policy.

up.label: Take the envelope and say nothing

text: A ward wants a bed that doesn't exist. {boss} says find one.

up.label: Take a bed from the next ward

text: {friend} knows a shortcut through the loading bay. It's off-limits.

up.label: Race through the bay with a patient

text: Three call bells at once. {rival} is on break. Again.

up.label: Run to all three at once

text: {friend} offers to show you how to take blood. "Don't faint."

up.label: Take blood from five patients

risk.result: You get the sixth one wrong.

text: The GPS says left. {friend} says right. Someone's not breathing.

up.label: Take the gamble and floor it

death.cause: The road got you before the call did.

text: You did everything right. It wasn't enough. The drive back is quiet.

up.label: Write it all up and ask for a break

risk.result: The report is a hard read.

text: You spot {rival}'s dosage mistake before it reaches the patient.

up.label: Report it and demand a review

text: Fourth night shift in a row. {crush} brings you a coffee at 4am.

up.label: Ask {crush} out for a drink

risk.result: The answer is a long pause.

text: The prescription looks off. The signature's wrong. The man is getting impatient.

up.label: Call the police yourself

text: An old man asks if he really needs all twelve of his pills.

up.label: Make a chart for every pill

risk.result: The chart is wrong in one place.

text: A kid bites {boss}'s finger. Everyone looks at you.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Sing to the kid

text: {rival} is spreading a rumour about you and {crush}.

up.label: Make a joke of the rumour

text: {boss} wants more veneers sold. This patient doesn't need any.

up.label: Refuse and tell the patient what's going on

text: Years of leaning over chairs. Your back is complaining.

up.label: Switch to part-time and learn the trade

text: Midnight. A farmer's cow is calving badly. It's raining sideways.

up.label: Drive through the flood

risk.result: The ford was deeper than it looked.

death.cause: The river took the car. And you.

text: A man counts out coins for his cat's surgery. He's short.

up.label: Pay the whole bill yourself

risk.result: The cat does fine. Your bank does not.

text: Everyone says it's a virus. Something about the rash bothers you.

up.label: Order everything and stay late

text: Hour 30 of your shift. You've read the same chart three times.

up.label: Take on another patient

text: Your regular client cancels for the third week. Something's wrong.

up.label: Visit them at home

text: {boss} reviews your notes. "These are... thin."

up.label: Re-do every note and ask for a review

text: It's scorching. {boss} wants the slab poured before lunch.

up.label: Pour it all and finish early

death.cause: The heat took you off the scaffold.

text: The frame's a few millimetres out. Nobody would ever know.

up.label: Rebuild the whole frame overnight

text: {boss} swears the circuit's dead. Your tester disagrees.

up.label: Cut the wire to prove it

text: The new apprentice has wired the switch upside down. Proudly.

up.label: Hand them the whole job

text: 3am. Burst pipe. The caller is crying.

up.label: Go now and fix it by dawn

text: You pull a diamond ring out of the drain.

up.label: Hand it back and tell the paper

risk.result: The papers get the story wrong.

text: Hammer. Thumb. {rival} laughs.

up.label: Laugh and keep sawing

text: The stairs are due Friday. It's Thursday. They're not stairs yet.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Finish by Friday if it kills you

text: {boss} wants you to tell an old lady she needs new brakes. She doesn't.

up.label: Fix the brakes for free

text: "It makes a noise." That's all the customer says.

up.label: Strip the engine to find it

text: Forty covers at once. {boss} is shouting. {rival} has burnt the risotto.

up.label: Take over the pass

text: The steak hits the floor. Nobody saw.

up.label: Serve it with a flourish

text: Hour fourteen. The white lines are starting to dance.

up.label: Push on to the depot

risk.result: You nod off for a second.

death.cause: The lines stopped dancing. So did the truck.

text: A hitchhiker in the rain. Company rules say no.

up.label: Drive them home

risk.result: They were not who they said.

text: Third dry month. The water tank is nearly empty.

up.label: Sell all the stock and buy a new tank

risk.result: The price of stock has dropped.

text: A calf is coming backwards. It's 2am. {friend} is asleep.

up.label: Deliver it single-handed

risk.result: The calf is fine. You are not.

text: The office party ended at midnight. You start at 5.

up.label: Clean the whole building by dawn

text: A diamond ring, behind the toilet in a rich client's bathroom.

up.label: Hand it in with a note

risk.result: The note is lost. So is the credit.

text: The scanner says you're 12% under quota. {boss} is watching the screen.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Work through lunch and the next

text: {rival} reverses the forklift into a pallet of TVs. They point at you.

up.label: Report {rival} for dangerous driving

text: The printer jams again. {boss} looks straight at you.

up.label: Rebuild the printer

text: Two directors booked the same room. Both say they booked it first.

up.label: Book a hall for everyone

text: Last day of the month. You're one sale short of quota.

up.label: Promise the moon

risk.result: They want the moon in writing.

text: {rival} is about to close YOUR client. They found the lead in your notes.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Phone the client first

text: Your till is $20 short at close. Nobody's watching the cameras.

up.label: Count the whole vault

text: An old woman wants all her savings in cash. Her "grandson" waits outside.

up.label: Follow the grandson out

risk.result: He turns out to be armed.

text: A young family needs a loan. Their numbers are... hopeful.

up.label: Approve it and sponsor them

risk.result: Their numbers did not work out.

text: Bonus season. {rival}'s is bigger than yours.

up.label: Threaten to quit

text: Tax season. Your inbox has 214 unread. It's 9pm.

up.label: Stay all night and clear the lot

text: A client asks you to get 'creative' with their expenses.

up.label: Do it and cover your tracks

text: The filing deadline is 5pm. It's 4:40. The courier is stuck in traffic.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Sprint the whole way

risk.result: You twist an ankle on the steps.

text: {boss} presents your research to the partners as their own.

up.label: Go to the partners with proof

text: Your client just admitted, off the record, that they did it.

up.label: Fight the case of your life

text: {boss} wants 2,000 billable hours this year. You're on track for 1,600.

up.label: Work every weekend

text: Friday, 5:55pm. The website is down. Your last change went in at 5:50.

up.label: Roll back and rewrite it

text: {rival} leaves 47 comments on your code review. Most are nitpicks.

up.label: Rewrite the whole module

text: Ticket #4,112: 'computer broken.' It's unplugged.

risk.result: Then it went a bit wrong.

up.label: Fix everyone's computers on the floor

text: The server upgrade has to happen overnight. Someone has to stay.

up.label: Do the upgrade and the rack move

text: {boss} wants the new campaign to 'go viral'. Budget: $0.

left.label: Explain that's not how it works

up.label: Fly a drone through the office

text: Pitch meeting in ten minutes. {rival} is presenting your idea.

up.label: Take over the pitch

text: Ninety essays on the same poem. It's Sunday night.

up.label: Write long feedback for every essay

risk.result: You are asleep by essay forty.

text: A parent tells {boss} their kid "deserved an A". {boss} wants a word.

up.label: Host a meeting with the parent and the principal

text: You pull over a speeder. It's {friend}'s mother. She's already crying.

up.label: Let her off and drive her home

text: {rival} pockets cash from an evidence bag. He sees you see it.

risk.result: An internal inquiry names you too.

up.label: Report him to the chief

text: Smoke pouring out. Someone screams there's a dog inside.

up.label: Go in with no mask

death.cause: The roof came down on the hall.

text: {friend} signs you up for the charity calendar. Shirtless.

up.label: Pose in full gear

text: A toddler bites another toddler. Then looks at you. Then bites again.

up.label: Hold both toddlers

text: Twelve kids, all asleep at once. It's never happened before.

up.label: Do the paperwork and the floors

risk.result: One wakes up. Then they all do.

text: A customer demands a refund on a toaster. It's clearly been in a bath.

up.label: Hold the line and call the manager

risk.result: It turns into a shouting match.

text: An old man slips a tin of soup into his coat.

up.label: Chase him down the street

text: {rival} posts their latte art swan. It's annoyingly good.

up.label: Pour a swan, a heart and a rose

text: Your 7am regular hasn't come in for a week. Today she's back, red-eyed.

up.label: Give her a free breakfast

text: The client wants the logo bigger. And the other logo bigger. And both to pop.

up.label: Redo it five times for free

text: {rival} presents your poster in the meeting. As theirs.

up.label: Call it out in front of everyone

text: A brown envelope on your desk. Inside: the mayor's expenses. All of them.

up.label: Publish it with a front page

text: Police want your source's name. Your source is {friend}.

up.label: Go to court to protect them

text: Orders come in. Your unit deploys next month.

up.label: Volunteer to lead the first wave

text: 5am drill in the rain. {rival} is slacking at the back.

up.label: Lead the whole unit through

text: {boss} hands you a list. Cut three names from your team by Friday.

up.label: Offer to take the cut yourself

text: The board wants growth this quarter. The numbers say no.

up.label: Resign and tell the press
